ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO_GROUP_SRC B ON A.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
AND COALESCE(A.MISCELLANEOUSID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.MISCELLANEOUSID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
